name: AV1 Intel Arc QSV [Single ICQ, Seek-Heal Fallback V15]
description: Automates Intel Arc QSV AV1 encoding at ICQ 22 for eligible video. A full source precheck and candidate validation guard replacement; if AV1 does not reduce size, the flow tries a validated seek-healing remux using the source video. Supported HDR and Dolby Vision paths use guarded metadata handling; unsupported or ambiguous sources are held. Audio and subtitle tracks follow the flow’s retention policy. Item-scoped Arr searches run only for confirmed source corruption; ISO deletion requests an Arr rescan. Discord reports success, failure, already-processed files, and ISO deletion/rescan status.

flowPlugins.name: Arr: ISO rescan or confirmed source-corruption search
